args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Service now healthy on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Detected the failure:** checkout-api's latest deploy v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back:** identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back all regions to it. Verified the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action taken; the on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation.

transcript.reasoning_content: First, check deployment history to find most recent healthy release.
